reason: B is better grounded and testable: cryo-rolling plus annealing has direct prior evidence of simultaneously improving strength and ductility in AlCoCrFeNi2.1, with measurable microstructural and tensile outcomes against an as-cast control. Although it is arguably a two-stage treatment and parts of its pile-up/short-range-order mechanism are overstated, A’s proposed selective interface incoherency or “decohesion” is poorly supported, difficult to control, and could instead promote cracking.
